profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hello! I'm Anthony, a software engineer open to work with experience in overseeing the complete software development life cycle. My skills encompass requirement engineering, design, coding, debugging, and maintenance. I've played a pivotal role in the development of adaptable solutions supporting UI and functional changes. Proficient in an array of technologies, including JavaScript, React, C#, .NET, SQL, C++, Java, and Python.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Teaching Assistant for Discrete Structures, a logical mathematics course designed for Computer Science students. Spent 2-10 hours per week teaching discrete structures principles to undergraduate students alongside fellow teaching assistants and professors; held office hours to provide more personal, one-on-one help to students; graded exams and homework assignments for the class
